headline: Cory Stearns, American Ballet Theater Star, on Retirement and the Pains of Aging
context: Stearns, a longtime principal at American Ballet Theater, has stepped down. He talks about being pushed to leave and the pains and boons of growing older.

sources.name: The New York Times
